contact.basis: Park-side forecourt just beyond the central entrance steps; independent ground reference.

verticalDatum: Hong Kong Principal Datum (HKPD); native Hong Kong 1980 Grid, EPSG:2326
attribution: Lands Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; public5m-grid DTM
method: Unmodified original5m terrain cells clipped to a local ASCII grid, WGS84 positions projected to Hong Kong1980 Grid (EPSG:2326) and bilinearly sampled at pixel centers. Values are not flattened or fitted to architecture. Source integer-height quantization and published accuracy remain; the2m local grid is oversampled evidence, not finer source resolution.
limitations: Official product metadata reports accuracy±5m at90% confidence, based on2014/2015 aerial photographs; no surveyed site accuracy claimed.
Data can contain vegetation, elevated roads and bridges; local streets/photos are checked independently.
Runtime terrain-contact placement samples its own host at the declared reference; compatibility with a different DEM remains host-dependent.
